items.actClause: AN ACT to authorize the town of Canandaigua, county of Ontario to discontinue the use of certain town lands as parkland and to sell and convey such lands
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S7903

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to authorize the town of Canandaigua, county of Ontario to
discontinue the use of certain town lands as parkland and to sell and
convey such lands


 PURPOSE :
Allows the Town of Canandaigua to discontinue and either sell at fair
market value or exchange municipally owned parklands which are no
longer needed for park purposes.

 SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS :
Section 1 authorizes the Town of Canandaigua, located in the County of
Ontario, to discontinue the use of municipally owned parklands
described in Section 2; to sell and convey them at fair market value;
or in exchange dedicate new parkland as described in Section 3 or make
improvements to existing park and recreational facilities as necessary
to equal fair market value.

Section 2 describes the parcels of land which are authorized by this
act to be discontinued.

Section 3 describes the replacement land to be dedicated as new park
land.

Section 4 requires the Town of Canandaigua to dedicate additional town
owned land and/or cause funds to be made available for capital
improvements to existing park and recreational facilities equal to the
fair market value and/or usefulness of the lands to be alienated in
the event that the lands dedicated are not of equal to twice the size
or greater than the fair market value of the parklands that are to be
discontinued by this act.

Section 5 requires the Town of Canandaigua to be in full compliance
with any federal or state requirements pertaining to the alienation or
conversion of parklands, including satisfying the Secretary of the
Interior that such conversion complies with conditions that would
allow for the substitution of other lands that hold an equivalent fair
market value.

Section 6 is the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :
The Town of Canandaigua in 2002 obtained 34.871 acres which was
dedicated for parkland.  However approximately 13 acres has been and
continues to be used for non park purposes, including a right of way
for a road that provides access to the park and recently constructed
pump house for the Town of Canandaigua's public water system. The Town
has been awarded a 2006 Environmental Protection Fund grant in order
to improve the park, but the grant cannot be received until the
outstanding non-park purposes problem is resolved. In order to address
issue the Town has identified 13 acres of town owned land, which is
currently being farmed directly adjacent to the current parklands. The
town proposes to dedicate this land for park purposes and formally
discontinue those portions of the current parklands which constitute a
non-conforming use of park lands. However, such an action would
require authorization at the State level due to the property's
location on a parcel of parkland.

 LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
None.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
To be determined.
 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.
